notes: Coinage absorbs and formalizes the weight-standard C outputs of Phase 0. Gift network D constraints are not fully dissolved.
Roman commercial law structures (C from Phase 1) are absorbed into canon law and merchant custom. Empire administration D dissolves but is replaced by church and guild D.
Double-entry bookkeeping C from Phase 2 directly enables state finance and joint-stock instruments. Usury D is partially resolved by new legal fictions (commenda partnership).
Joint-stock and national debt C from Phase 3 is absorbed into classical theory's treatment of capital. Bullionist D is analytically demolished by Smith and Hume.
Comparative advantage and price theory C from Phase 4 is re-derived in utility terms by marginalists. Labor D (labor theory of value) is dissolved by marginal utility. Clean break.
Equilibrium framework D from Phase 5 becomes a constraint (cannot explain unemployment). Marginalist micro C survives as the foundation for Keynesian macro. N collapses at Phase 5.
Keynesian fiscal tools C from Phase 6 survive but are subordinated. Bretton Woods D collapses 1971. Multiplier theory D is challenged by rational expectations critique.
Monetarist and deregulation C from Phase 7 is institutionalized as Washington Consensus. Keynesian D is reduced to a residual. Rational expectations D becomes mainstream.
Efficient market H and DSGE D from Phase 8 are falsified. C outputs (financial engineering instruments) become toxic. No clear replacement N has emerged. Child N is pending.
